elements.name: sprout launches the full graphics pipeline

steps.name: the machine is booted
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Starting full pipeline (graphics + input)" within 60s
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Spawned bristle" within 60s
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Spawned bloom" within 120s
the serial output should contain "bloom: compositor service starting" within 120s
the serial output should contain "bloom: service loop started" within 180s
the serial output should contain "First frame rendered" within 180s

elements.name: sprout launches the default Wayland client

steps.name: the machine is booted
the serial output should contain "wayland-server: listening on /run/wayland-0" within 180s
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Spawned wayland_hello" within 180s
the serial output should contain "wayland_hello: connected to /run/wayland-0" within 180s
the serial output should contain "wayland_hello: pistil text renderer loaded with default /share/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf" within 180s
the serial output should contain "wayland-server: xdg_surface obj=" within 180s

elements.name: sprout launches the Wayland clock client

steps.name: the machine is booted
the serial output should contain "SPROUT: Spawned clock" within 180s
the serial output should contain "clock: connected to /run/wayland-0" within 180s
the serial output should contain "clock: pistil DSEG7 text renderer loaded with /share/fonts/DSEG7Classic-Regular.ttf" within 180s
the serial output should contain "System clock tick:" within 180s
the serial output should contain "clock: tick local=" within 180s

elements.name: rtc anchors the system clock before the Wayland clock displays realtime

steps.name: the machine is booted
the serial output should contain "RTC: claimed /sys/devices/isa-0070" within 180s
the serial output should contain "RTC: System clock anchored" within 180s
the serial output should contain "System clock tick:" within 180s
the serial output should contain "clock: tick local=" within 180s
